title: SmiteMod
description: strikes a player with lightning + custom sound
body:
SmiteMod adds a simple but powerful command to your server — /smite <player>.
Strike any player with a lightning bolt instantly, complete with a custom sound effect. Perfect for server admins who want a fun way to punish or mess with their friends.
Features:

/smite <player> — strikes the target with lightning
Custom sound effect on hit
Works with @a, @r and other selectors
Requires Op-Level 2

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.21.8
NeoForge 21.8.31
